answer: An admission auction blocks fake identities. Every epoch opens 100 slots: applicants bid, the top 100 win, losers refunded, winners lock bids 20 epochs, slashed if they cheat. The fable of free entry ends: like a reef where each coral pays its place, this ocean admits only stakers. At a median bid of 40 tokens, 100 fakes cost 4,000 tokens locked 20 epochs, nothing to recover. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and earns its full share.
